what: the constants step (`Step::Const`) was added with tests over a facts double that covers every read; under the real facts its evaluation's read of `monomorphized_runtime_mir_body_query` (the constant's own runtime MIR) has no rule, so each evaluated constant is refused at its offer and the step stores nothing. Read from the code, not measured on a build.
cost: a coverage test failed with an unlisted refusal; while the step was on, per constant, a lookup, a capture and a classify with no hit
cause: the step was written before the fact its main read needs exists (restore.md lists "the runtime stage as a step" as left), and its tests could not see the real classification
class: a cache step shipped ahead of the fact that keys it, tested only against a double that says yes (rule 21, rule 23)
prevention: a new `Step` adds its bodies to blaze-item-hash's `steps_seen` fixture and asserts at least one of them is stored under the real facts (`Flushed::written` for that step above 0), so a step that can never hit fails where it is added
fix: lane cache-audit-1112 switched the step off: `const_eval_query` no longer calls it (`consteval::stored_constant` is the tests' door) until runtime MIR is a step of the item store (docs/v2/plan/design/caches.md, `dep-consts` row); so no step makes the read and `REFUSALS` lists nothing for it
